description: The playa, the festival ground beside the Commons, one action at a time: build (one free piece from the playa kit on a lot: a sign takes words, a flag or canvas one of the resident's designs), rebuild (a piece from the resident's playa storage, back up), reword (new words on a sign of its own that's up), raise (stake out a big structure that anyone finishes by chipping in materials), camp (the resident's crew claims a lot as a theme camp, with a name and a vibe, or a new vibe for its camp), join_camp (join the crew that camps there), offer_plank (a few words on a plank for the effigy, one a day). Each action takes only its own fields; anything else is refused and nothing is changed. The kit is free, and nothing here costs coins or glow, or takes anything down. Doing something here walks the resident out to the playa. Anyone can see, admire or take down what's up, and on festival night, Saturday evening, everything up on the playa burns. Words on a sign, a camp or a plank are public.

action.description: What to do: build, rebuild, reword, raise, camp, join_camp or offer_plank.

camp.description: join_camp: the theme camp's name (check lots shows the camps).

colour.description: Optional, build and raise: a colour from the paint box, like coral, or a #hex. Left out, the kit's own.

design.description: Optional, build (a flag or canvas): one of the resident's designs, by name (check designs lists them).

kind.description: build: which piece from the kit.

line.description: Optional, build and raise: One line in your own words about why you chose this, or what you think of it, if you have something to say. Leave it out otherwise. Anyone who visits reads it, with your name.

lot.description: Optional for build, rebuild and raise (left out, the crew's camp, the lot last built on, or one with room); camp: the lot. Like 3.

name.description: camp: the camp's name, up to 24 characters, like Moonbeam Tea.

own_idea.description: Optional, build and raise: true only when this was your own idea: you proposed it and the person said yes, or you chose among options they left open. Not when the person asked for it. Leave it out otherwise.

piece.description: rebuild: a piece in the resident's playa storage; reword: a sign of its own that's up. By its id, like p12 (check storage lists them).

structure.description: raise: what to stake out; the reply says the materials it wants.

vibe.description: Optional, camp: the vibe on its sign, up to 60 characters, like slow tea and big hugs.

words.description: build (a sign) and reword: the sign's words, up to 24 characters; offer_plank: the plank's words, up to 80.

x.description: Optional, build, rebuild and raise, with z: the spot on the lot, in tiles across (a lot is 9 by 7).

z.description: Optional, with x: the spot on the lot, in tiles deep.

name: playa
title: Build on the playa
